results.title: Midjourney Statistics 2026: Users, Revenue & Plans
results.author: Finn Hillebrandt
highlights:
In March 2026, The Information reported that founder David Holz called the company profitable. You can't verify that, though. Midjourney publishes neither a paying-user total nor audited annual accounts.

...

The short version:

TL;DR Key Takeaways

- Midjourney does not publish audited accounts. A June 2025 lawsuit attributes more than $200M in revenue to 2023 and describes $300M as the reported 2024 revenue.
- Contrary Research estimated ARR at about $500M in May 2025. David Holz has called the company profitable but gives no profit figures.
- Midjourney publishes no totals for accounts or paying subscribers. Its Discord server showed 18,532,565 members on October 17, 2026.

...

## 2. User Numbers and Community

Midjourney publishes no official totals for registered accounts, paying subscribers, or daily active users. One directly observable figure is the member count shown for its official Discord server. The Discord server directory displayed the following when checked on October 17, 2026:

- 18,532,565 server members
- 519,910 members shown as online

DemandSage reports 17.5 million Discord members in December 2023 and about 19.26 million at an unspecified point in 2024. The same page gives 19.94 million for December 2025, but elsewhere says 19.83 million for January 2026.

...

### How many users does Midjourney have?

There is no total: Midjourney gives no figure for registered, paying, or active users. According to Midjourney’s account guide, Midjourney accounts can use the website and Discord. The official Discord server counts only its server members.

## Midjourney

Midjourney runs the largest AI art server. The public directory showed 18,553,243 members on October 21. That count comes from Collony's server ranking. It is lower than the 21 million figure circulated in 2025.

Midjourney also offers a web interface beyond the chat platform. Server counts therefore do not cover its full user base. The alpha release of the eighth major version appeared on March 17, 2026. Version V8.1 followed on April 14. Version V8.2 was listed on July 24, according to Wikipedia: Midjourney.

...

## DigitalOcean list

The DigitalOcean article "10 Best AI Discord Servers to Join in 2025" was published on April 29, 2025. Its entries include the company's own server, several model makers, learning communities, a voice platform and Midjourney.

Midjourney is the only image generator among them. Inclusion is a visibility signal, not a membership count. Neither list measures daily messages or unique active members.

Midjourney's revenue comes from four subscription plans priced at $10, $30, $60 and $120 a month, according to Midjourney's official plans page. Sacra estimates that with about 21 million Discord community members and a blended average price near $30 a month, Midjourney has roughly 1.4 million paying subscribers.

...

## How many users does Midjourney actually have?

Midjourney's user base has been tracked primarily through its Discord server, since the platform launched there in 2022. It's widely estimated in the range of 20 to 21 million registered accounts. Multiple independent trackers monitor Discord's own public member counts closely to arrive at this same general figure. That figure counts registered accounts, not daily active users. Daily actives run meaningfully lower.

Daily active user estimates cluster fairly tightly between 1.2 and 2.5 million. Multiple independent analyses of Discord activity patterns arrive at this same range. The gap between registered accounts and daily actives is a normal pattern for any large community platform. It's not unique to Midjourney specifically. Still, it's worth keeping the two numbers separate, when evaluating the platform's real, active reach.
